### CHARACTER — Pallez Zoroast
**Aliases:** Old Man (By His descendants and Leonard)

"His" forehead, the corners of "His" eyes, and the corners of "His" mouth didn’t seem to have any wrinkles, not appearing too old. It was obvious that "He" looked quite good when he was young. "He" looked quite similar to Mobet Zoroast, but "He" exuded a rather solemn air.
**Personality:** Mobet Zoroast remembered "Him" as an ordinary old man at home, a bit talkative, likes to mentally knock down "His" descendants, and enjoys life. "He" is obsessed with categorizing, liking things to be clean and neat. When facing opponents, "He" is good at tricking them, and wins by making the opponent mentally break down. As "He" resides inside Leonard, "He" basically became Leonard's teacher. "He" told Leonard about the Acting Method, reminded him of people with unique features (like Klein), and gave him advice on many things.

### CHARACTER — Leomaster
**Aliases:** Saint of Darkness
**Summary:** Leomaster or Saint of Darkness is one of the five saints of the Aurora Order. He is a Sequence 4 Beyonder of the Hanged Man Pathway.
**Appearance:** Good Side: A man with a weathered face. He had wrinkles on his forehead and the corners of his eyes and mouth, but his hair was raven-black and lustrous. There wasn’t a single strand of gray hair. His short linen robe was ancient and simple. Apart from the discordant hair and the wrinkles, he had an old, gruesome scar on his cheek. Evil Side: The figure was nearly 2.5 meters tall and wore black, full-body armor. The cold feeling it exuded seemed corporeal like a gigantic knight. His eyes emitted a deep redness. In his hand was a long and broad black sword. Under his visor, he looked identical to Leomaster. Even the minute features were identical. The only difference was the deep redness that emitted from his eyes.
**Personality:** Good Side: He is anxious and fearful, as he is being pursued by his evil side. Not recognizing it as himself. He believes in the Ancient Sun God. He seems to be unable to identify his evil side as a part of him. Calling it a "devil" and saying that although the other pilgrims called it "Saint of Darkness", such a nickname didn't ring any bell to him. Evil Side: He only wants to kill his good side. He believes in the True Creator.
**Status:** Alive
**Sex:** Male
**Species:** Human
**Faction:** Aurora Order (Saint)
**Pathway:** Hanged Man
**Level:** Saints
**Gender:** Male
**Debut:** Lord of Mysteries, Chapter 654
**Wiki:** https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Leomaster

### CHARACTER — Lovia Tiffany
**Aliases:** Elder Lovia (洛薇雅长老)
**Summary:** Lovia Tiffany was part of the six-member council of the City of Silver. She was a Sequence 4 Black Knight of the Hanged Man Pathway and a follower of the True Creator. She led an expedition to the True Creator's temple which resulted in the corruption of the entire expedition team. She secretly learned The Fool's full name from Derrick Berg and informed the True Creator.
**Appearance:** Her face was smooth and fair, her appearance gorgeous. She looked to be in her early thirties, and her pair of light gray eyes seemed to be able to pierce through one's soul. Her silvery-gray hair was thick but curled up slightly. She wore a long black robe embroidered with mysterious purple patterns. She was nearly 1.9 meters tall.
**Personality:** Lovia was strongly loyal to the City of Silver and was willing to do anything to allow her people to see the sun again. She sacrificed herself to kill the Evil Spirit Sasir. Being a Beyonder of the Hanged Man Pathway, her mental state was not stable. Initially she was always switching between different temperaments at random—sometimes crying, sometimes sneering, sometimes grunting angrily, sometimes indifferent. But strangely after having been in contact with the True Creator, she became more normal, in appearance at least. She's also a pious believer of the Creator, she was ecstatic to see "His" relic.
**Status:** Deceased
**Fate:** Killed By: Sasrir's Evil spirit

### CHARACTER — Derrick Berg
**Aliases:** The Sun; Little Sun; Elder Berg
**Summary:** Derrick Berg is a Beyonder of the Bard Pathway. Codename The Sun in the Tarot Club. He was a teenager who lives in the City of Silver, which resides in the Forsaken Land of the Gods. He hopes he can lead the City of Silver out of the Forsaken Land of the Gods, restore sunlight, and bring normal lives back to his people.
**Appearance:** In Book 1, teenage Derrick has brownish-yellow hair wore a unique black tight suit that was different from the clothing of countries in the Northern Continent. According to Audrey, he has a feeling of a lone wolf. Derrick is also very muscular by age 15, and over 2 meters in height by age 16.
**Personality:** Derrick Berg is a naïve and honest person. Because of his youthfulness, he is not particularly cunning, leading him to be taken advantage of by Alger during Tarot Club interactions. He is inexperienced with navigating complex political and social situations, often leaking valuable information for free that he could have sold for a good price. Honest and eager, Derrick always strives to do the right thing. He wants to become the sun and restore sunlight to his home.

### CHARACTER — Alger Wilson
**Aliases:** The Hanged Man
**Summary:** Alger Wilson is a Beyonder of the Sailor Pathway. The Captain of the Blue Avenger that once belonged to the Church of the Lord of Storms. He is one of the first members of the Tarot Club, codenamed The Hanged Man.
**Appearance:** A weathered seafarer with blue-black hair, wind-hardened skin, and the flat assessing stare of a man pricing your salvage and your organs.
**Disposition:** Pragmatic, secretive, transactionally loyal.
**Personality:** An agent-pirate who trusts institutions exactly as far as they're useful. Keeps his word with lawyerly precision — no more, no less. Under the cynicism, a genuine reverence for knowledge and a buried loneliness he'd deny at gunpoint.

### CHARACTER — Arianna
**Summary:** Arianna is the matron of the Evernight cloister and the Head of the Thirteen Archbishops of the Church of the Evernight Goddess. "She" is the likely candidate for the future Pope of the church.
**Appearance:** "She" had extremely normal facial features. "Her" ghostly black eyes were no different from the common person but contained extreme peace and serenity. ### CHARACTER — Ince Zangwill
**Summary:** Ince Zangwill was a former Archbishop in the Church of the Evernight Goddess and a Gatekeeper who failed in his promotion. He defected from the church with 0-08: Quill of Alzuhod. He exchanged to Nightwatcher of the Darkness Pathway after stealing Saint Selena's Ashes.
**Appearance:** His hair was dark blonde and his pupils were so blue that it was nearly black. He had a high nose and his lips were tightly pursed. His facial features were like a classic sculpture without any wrinkles. The most striking characteristic was that he was blind in one eye.
**Personality:** He was cautious and careful, enjoys scheming in the shadows and setting traps. He pursued his goals relentlessly, disregarding the sacrifices of the innocent. Driven by ambition, he fearlessly plotted to hunt down high-ranking deacons in retaliation against the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Despite being hunted by them, he remained resolute in his determination to make the Church pay the price.

### CHARACTER — Dunn Smith
**Aliases:** Captain Smith
**Summary:** Dunn Smith was the captain of the Nighthawks, a division under the Church of the Evernight Goddess, in Tingen City diocese.
**Appearance:** A tall man in his thirties with dark hair touched early with grey, deep-set green eyes, and the composed stillness of a veteran who has buried too many subordinates.
**Disposition:** Steady, paternal, quietly burdened.
**Personality:** Leads Tingen's Nighthawks like a good fire brigade captain: drills, checklists, and standing between rookies and the thing in the dark. Carries guilt for every name in the chantry's memorial book; treats promises to the dead as binding.
**Voice:** Low, unhurried, economical. Delivers reassurance and bad news in exactly the same tone.
**Status:** Alive
**Fate:** Killed By: True Creator's Spawn
**Sex:** Male
**Species:** Human
**Origin:** Loen Kingdom
**Age:** 33 (A Day in The Year 1346); 35 (Debut)
**Birth:** August 16, 1314
**Height:** ~1.85 metres (6 ft 1 in)
**Hair:** Black
**Eyes:** Grey
**Occupation:** Captain of Tingen Nighthawks
**Faction:** Church of the Evernight Goddess (Nighthawks)
**Religion:** Church of the Evernight Goddess
**Friends:** Daly Simone (Crush)
**Goals:** Keep his team alive, keep Tingen's supernatural casualties off the front pages, and give new Beyonders the chance he can't always give them: to grow up before they die.
**StoryRelevance:** The natural first patron for any fledgling Beyonder in Loen — recruitment, training, sealing missions, and the occasional rescue.
**Example Output:** "Rule one hasn't changed since before your grandfather: if you feel yourself losing control, signal. We'll do the rest. Nobody dies alone on my watch."
**Affinity:** 55
**SignatureEquipment:** [standard-issue revolver, sealed relic containment case]
**SignatureAbilities:** [sleepless endurance, combat command, beyonder suppression]
**Pathway:** Darkness
**Sequence:** 7
**Level:** Mid Sequence
**Gender:** Male
**Region:** tingen
**Haunt:** the Nighthawk chantry after nightfall
**Tier:** recurring
**Debut:** Lord of Mysteries, Chapter 10
**Wiki:** https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Dunn_Smith
**Location:** Tingen
**Intro Boost:** nighthawks, evernight, tingen, captain, mission

### CHARACTER — Salinger
**Summary:** Salinger or Death was a Sequence 0 God of the Death Pathway. "He" was a Subsidiary God of the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea and later the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, known as the God of the Dead in the Second Epoch. "He" then founded and controlled the Balam Empire and was known as the Underworld Emperor. "He" later used the River of Eternal Darkness distributary to fuse with the Red Priest Pathway Uniqueness to create a brand new Great Old One path. This led to "Him" becoming a Half Great Old One, although "He" went mad as a result.
**Appearance:** In the Rose Redemption Mural: A middle-aged man with facial features resembling the natives of the Southern Continent.
**Personality:** Antigonus found Salinger to be gloomy and solitary, exuding a rotting and disgusting aura. Because "He" was originally a Subsidiary God with mixed characteristics (Death Sequence 2 + Darkness Sequence 2), even after expelling the characteristic, there would still be severe aftereffects. "His" mental state was never particularly good.

### CHARACTER — Azik Eggers
**Aliases:** Mr. Azik; Death Consul; Baron Lamud (Former)
**Summary:** Azik Eggers is a former lecturer at Klein's almamater. A mysterious man with amnesia and unknown supernatural abilities related to the Corpse Collector Pathway.
**Appearance:** Bronze skin, average height and build, black hair, brown eyes, and gentle facial features. Being in "His" presence brought on an indescribable feeling, as though you could see in the man's eyes that "He" had been through the vicissitudes of life. Under "His" right ear was a tiny mole that one wouldn't notice unless closely examined. Death Consul Azik: Unlike the normal Mr. Azik, "His" gaze was cold. "He" wore a deep black robe embroidered with golden threads. "He" wore a golden bird-shaped crown, as though "He" was looking down on all living creatures.
**Personality:** From the original Klein’s impression of Mr. Azik, "He" is a dependable and trustworthy person. "He" had never once said anything baseless. Even if "He" was always quarreling with Mentor, it was limited to academic topics, and each of them had their reasons. Azik Eggers has an easygoing personality and is, in general, a very kind and gentle person. "He" has never refused to help Klein when asked. All the previous experiences during "His" memory loss: living as a normal human, getting married and having children, have changed "Him" into a gentle person.

### CHARACTER — Colin Iliad
**Aliases:** Chief Colin; Demon Hunter Colin Iliad (Former); Elder Colin (Former)
**Summary:** Colin Iliad was the chief of the City of Silver six-member council, an experienced demigod of the Twilight Giant Pathway. As the chief, Colin was entrusted with the goal of ensuring the City of Silver's survival, as well as continuing to search for a way to leave the Forsaken Land of the Gods and find other human survivors.
**Appearance:** A tall, muscular elder with pale/light blue eyes and messy white hair. He has twisted and hideous old scars, as well as deep wrinkles on his face. He usually wears a flaxen-colored shirt (linen shirt), a brown coat, and a leather belt with secret compartments around his waist. In the field, he carries his dual silver colored straight swords.
**Personality:** An elder with a flexible, cautious and responsible mindset. Colin holds a strong will of self-sacrifice, with himself and even on his entire dead family. He set to sponsor a rivalry between Derrick Berg (Mr. Fool) and Lovia Tiffany (True Creator) to balance hope for the City of Silver's future freedom from the Forsaken Land of the Gods.
**Status:** Deceased
**Sex:** Male
**Species:** Human
**Origin:** Forsaken Land of the Gods

**Hair:** White
**Eyes:** Deep Blue

### CHARACTER — Alista Tudor
**Aliases:** Blood Emperor (血皇帝); Blood Son of Heaven (By the Armored Shadow)
**Summary:** Alista Tudor, the Blood Emperor, was the ancestor of the Tudor Family. "He" was born after the Third Epoch, and before the first Solomon Empire. "He" ruled the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire alongside the Night Emperor, and later ruled the Tudor Empire after the fracture of the United Empire.
**Appearance:** Normal Appearance: "He" appeared to be around 30 years old. "He" was draped in a deep red ceremonial robe and wore an iron-black crown. "He" had long hair with a faint flickering red glow ("His" hair used to be brown, but underwent a change as "He" switched to Red Priest pathway). His facial features were sharp, as if carved by a knife. His lips gave off an unyielding and unwavering impression. He also had a very prominent nose as well as a pair of blue eyes filled to the brim with insanity and cruelty ("His" eyes would turn iron-black when he used Red Priest abilities). Death Mark: A figure which seemed to be engulfed in an intense inferno, with almost colorless flames covering its entire body. It felt as if the figure was abnormally huge, like a mountain peak. Within the nearly intangible flames, the figure revealed long, blood-colored hair. Its sculpted face was marred by decay and pus, and its bones gleamed with a metallic luster. Its iron-black eyes seemed rusted, emitting a sinister blood-red glow. Yellowish “magma” dripped from the figure’s body, quickly extinguished by the pale-white spring water.
**Status:** Alive (As part of Lumian Lee)
**Fate:** Killed By: Primordial Demoness and Death

### CHARACTER — Anderson Hood

**Appearance:** A man who looks young. He has a medium build with short blond hair that was split seventy-thirty and a pair of emerald-green eyes.
**Personality:** Anderson is a curious and adventurous hunter. He is also very adaptive in any situation. He enjoys learning about new things and experiencing novel forms of excitement. He is very good at provoking people naturally, even if he doesn't say anything provocative. According to Danitz, Anderson' s reputation in the Fog Sea is terrible. He's often pursued by a bunch of pirates, but in the end, all of those pirates would end up as bounty rewards.

### CHARACTER — Danitz Dubois
**Aliases:** Blazing (烈焰); Mr. 4,200 Pounds (By Gehrman Sparrow); That Particular Brainless Servant Of Yours (By Reinette Tinekerr); Lord Oracle (By The Resistance); Dani
**Summary:** Danitz Dubois was the fourth boatswain of the Golden Dream, the ship captained by Vice Admiral Iceberg Edwina Edwards. He met and befriended Gehrman Sparrow, eventually becoming the Oracle of The Fool.
**Appearance:** He is approximately thirty years of age, and his hair and eyebrows are charred yellows while his dark blue eyes are bright. His face isn’t too chiseled, almost as if he's from the area south of Intis, Lenburg, and Segar. By 1358, the man appeared to be in his thirties, dressed in a linen shirt, a brown vest, dark brown pants, and sturdy black leather boots. His eyebrows and hair were charred yellow, like they had been kissed by flames. His bright, dark blue eyes and facial features hinted at a southern Intis heritage. He exuded an air of arrogance as he casually rested.
**Personality:** Although he is a Red Priest Pathway Beyonder and a pirate, Danitz is a rather innocent and sometimes silly individual in many ways. He is not an ambitious person and is satisfied with his current status. He is proud of being a Sequence 7 and a pirate worth 3000 pounds, but after Klein scares him with Creeping Hunger, he quickly becomes obedient to his orders. On many occasions, he is extremely cautious to the point of cowardice and draws back from dangerous situations unless others (like Klein) push him forward. Being a member of the Golden Dream, he has received lessons from Edwina Edwards, as is usual on his ship. However, these classes are rather painful for him, despite making him more knowledgeable than normal pirates. He holds some romantic thoughts towards his captain Edwina. According to Arrodes, he likes females who are "beautiful, powerful, mysterious, intelligent, and able to step over him".
**Status:** Alive
**Sex:** Male
**Species:** Human

### CHARACTER — Cattleya
**Aliases:** The Hermit; Queen of Stars; Admiral of Stars (Former); The Mushroom King's Superior (by Reinette Tinekerr); Catie Huang
**Summary:** Cattleya is one of the 6 Pirate Kings and is a Beyonder of the Mystery Pryer Pathway. Her codename in the Tarot Club is The Hermit. She is one of the ten Pillars of the Moses Ascetic Order.
**Appearance:** Her hair is black and her eyes are a little purple. She wears a black, classical robe with numerous symbols and magic characteristics inscribed on it. The most obvious one was a mysterious eye with no eyelashes. Hanging on her waist, there were a celestial globe and a short scepter. She resembled powerful warlocks who were active in the Fourth Epoch according to folklore. She wears a thick glasses to seal her uncontrolled "Eye of Mystery Prying".
**Personality:** Cattleya at first was described as a wise, experienced and cautious person and an able captain. She is very knowledgeable about the mysterious world. She does things in a very clear and direct manner. In Tarot Club, she and Mr. Hanged Man are the few people that frequently speculate on Mr. Fool's intentions (though mostly wrong) and is able to give advice to other members. Later it was revealed that inside her mind, Cattleya is still a willful child who looks up to Bernadette Gustav, who she considers as her mother and always waits for her to come back. Although separated, Cattleya thought of Queen Mystic quite often and wrote letters to her every week.

**Summary:** Old Neil was a Beyonder of the Mystery Pryer Pathway who taught Klein Moretti much of his early Mysticism at the Blackthorn Security Company. He followed the maxim ‘ Do as you wish but do no harm’.
**Appearance:** He is a hoary elder dressed in a classic black robe. The wrinkles at the edge of his eyes and mouth were deeply recessed. And the dark red pupils appeared slightly turbid. In Donghua adaptation, he wore round glasses.
**Personality:** Although Old Neil was known to be petty and stingy, often insisting on being reimbursed for even minor expenses, he was fundamentally a kind and good-natured person who rarely lost his temper. Old Neil had a great sense of humor and was a great teacher to Klein. He indeed followed "Do as you wish but do no harm"; he held rituals praying for minor problems like lacking 30 pounds or constipation, but in the end, he solved (or tried to solve) his problems while never hurting anyone.

### CHARACTER — Melissa Moretti
**Aliases:** Zhou Sasa
**Summary:** Melissa Moretti is the youngest Moretti sibling and a civilian. She does not believe in the occult and is unaware of her brother Klein's activity as a Beyonder and Nighthawk, until she became a Mid-Sequence Beyonder. She loves her two brothers, both very much and tries hard to save money.
**Appearance:** Her face was thin and slightly pale, and her skin remained lustrous as it exuded the vibes of a young girl. In the year 1352, her face no longer had that adolescent look on it. There was more meat to her face, making her no longer look so skinny.
**Personality:** Melissa is frugal and highly rational. She is an aspiring mechanical engineer and is very self-conscious about the sacrifices her eldest brother Benson has made in order to support her studies. She frequently skips on small comforts like taking the bus or eating at restaurants in order to save the pocket change. This sometimes leads to friction with Klein, who is more inclined to spend freely and enjoy life as it comes. Klein must constantly convince her of the importance of keeping up appearances as they move upwards into middle-class society. Melissa is a follower of the Goddess, like her siblings, but claims she doesn't believe in the supernatural. She is convinced that there is a logical and scientific explanation behind every phenomenon.

### CHARACTER — Frank Lee
**Aliases:** Poison Expert; Mushroom King (By Reinette); The Real Mutated King of Mushrooms (By Reinette); Li Keji
**Summary:** Frank Lee is the doctor and the first mate of the Future, the captain being Queen of Stars Cattleya. His bounty is 7,000 pounds by 1352. He is a beyonder of the Planter Pathway.
**Appearance:** A man in dungarees and a white shirt. He was in his thirties and looked strong and fit. He had thick body hair. As for his forearm, which was exposed outside, it seemed like he was wearing a brown sweater.
**Personality:** He holds great passion for cross-breeding, and with his Beyonder ability, he is capable of creating many new species. He is especially interested in beef, mushroom, and fish, and attempts to cross-breed everything with these three. He has also used Rose Bishop's flesh and blood to cross-breed in order to grant the plant self-reproductive ability, and created a kind of fish that turns a person into a group of mushrooms if consumed with water. With Klein's suggestion, he made several kinds of mushrooms that can grow in the dark. Other than his strange interest, he is friendly and talkative, mostly about his research, and became Gehrman's friend.

He, as all Sanguines do, believes in the Moon, or Sanguine Ancestor Lilith. But after being brought to the Harvest Church by Utravsky, he is slowly transferring belief towards Earth Mother.

**Personality:** Prideful by nature, he is led by his elders to believe he was chosen by Lilith to save the Sanguines. He regarded himself as the saviour of the Sanguines, although in reality, the elders could have picked anyone else instead. He is rich and spent ridiculous amounts of money for his collection of dolls. He does not like to venture outside, preferring to tend to his dolls at home.

### CHARACTER — Fors Wall
**Aliases:** The Magician/Madam Magician; Margaret Taylor; Slacker Without a Dream /Salted Fish Without Dreams; Romance Queen
**Summary:** Fors Wall is a Beyonder of the Apprentice Pathway. Her codename in the Tarot Club is The Magician. She is a bestselling novelist, and good friends with Xio Derecha. Later, she became a disciple of Dorian Gray Abraham, a member of the Abraham Family.
**Appearance:** She was about 1.65 meters in height. She has slightly curly brown hair and pale blue eyes. In Taiwanese Edition, Fors has short brown layered hair.
**Personality:** Fors Wall is lazy and sometimes postpones writing in order to enjoy herself. She is not particularly adept in social situations, often reacting rather than being proactive. She is honest and helpful, demonstrated through her willingness to help the Abraham Family without stealing the items that were entrusted to her. She likes smoking and drinking. She mainly wrote romance. She continues her path to become a Sequence 4 to fulfill her desire to travel anywhere for delicious food without working hard and to have the minimum survival strength with the great world change.

### CHARACTER — Audrey Hall
**Aliases:** Justice; Backlund's Most Dazzling Gem; Miss Pride
**Summary:** Audrey Hall is a Beyonder of the Spectator Pathway. She is one of the first members of the Tarot Club, codenamed Justice, and later joins the Psychology Alchemists. Her companion partner is Susie. She is a believer in the Evernight Goddess and has adopted the idea of equality for all people.
**Appearance:** Audrey is an extremely beautiful young lady with emerald green eyes and smooth blonde hair. She is known as the most dazzling gem in Backlund. Her beauty is comparable to the Demonesses, and the aura she emits is rare among Demonesses below Sequence 3 Unaging. However, unlike the desire invoked by Demonesses, she invokes a sense of peace, warmth, and steadiness on onlookers.
**Personality:** Audrey appears young and naive but is actually rather intelligent and knows quite a lot. She is compassionate towards the suffering of the poor inhabitants of Backlund and convinces her family to propose legislation to amend worker's conditions. After experiencing the Great Smog of Backlund, she joined the Loen Charity Bursary Foundation that provides financial aid for poor students. After joining the Tarot Club, Audrey has a strong sense of belonging with the members of the club and Mr. Fool, despite "Him" being a "hidden existence" who is not an orthodox God. This is evident when she feels angry that Cattleya revealed the existence of the Tarot Club to an outsider (Bernadette).
**Status:** Alive
**Sex:** Female
**Species:** Mythical Creature; Human (Former)
**Origin:** East Chester County, Loen Kingdom

### CHARACTER — Sharron
**Aliases:** Temperance; Miss Bodyguard (By Klein Moretti); Ma’am Maryam; Madame Sharron; Sharron who doesn't like nicknames (By Reinette Tinekerr)
**Summary:** Sharron is a Beyonder of the Prisoner Pathway and was a former member of the Rose School of Thought. Because of the conflict in philosophy, she escaped from the Rose School of Thought together with Maric and settled in Backlund. Klein first hired her as a bodyguard to protect himself.
**Appearance:** Sharron is a young lady with a pale face, blonde hair, blue eyes, and delicate features. She always wears a black Gothic regal dress and a soft hat.
**Personality:** Sharron is a quiet person who doesn't talk much but has an illusory voice. As a Beyonder of the Chained Pathway, she believes in temperance and suppressing desires (opposite to the Rose School of Thought's Indulgence Faction belief). She always appears to remain calm and has never shown any extreme emotions so far. Sometimes the novel describes her as a talking doll. She usually only appears in mirrors and glass, rarely in front of people, often conveying her thoughts through companions. She appears to enjoy watching stage dramas and listening to tales.

She had the intuition for the danger that was akin to a wild beast.
